halomcc-your-journey-begins-467ebc6bb3.description: Qetella thomo ea phutuho kapa papali ea libapali tse ngata.
halomcc-your-journey-begins-467ebc6bb3.guideDescription: Ho notlolla katleho ea "Your Journey Begins" ka har'a Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o hloka feela ho phethela thomo efe kapa efe ea lets'olo kapa papali ea libapali tse ngata.

halomcc-just-getting-started-24ea4c9ab6.guideDescription: Ho notlolla katleho ea "Just Getting Started" ka har'a Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o hloka feela ho bolaea lira kapa libapali tse 100 morerong ofe kapa ofe oa lets'olo kapa papali ea libapali tse ngata.

halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.description: Halo: Reach: Fumana tekeno e patiloeng ea binary.
halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.guideDescription:
Ho notlolla katleho ea "I’m Sorry, Dave" ho Halo: Reach ka har'a Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o hloka ho fumana lehe le ikhethileng la Paseka le hlomphang David Candland, motsamaisi oa UI oa papali. Mona ke tataiso e qaqileng ea mokhoa oa ho e fumana:

1. Qala mosebetsi ofe kapa ofe oa lets'olo kapa 'mapa oa libapali tse ngata ho Halo: Reach.
2. Nka sebetsa seo **sena** se nang le tšobotsi ea ho atametsa. Mehlala e tloaelehileng e kenyelletsa Assault Rifle kapa Plasma Pistol.
3. Tobetsa konopo ea katametso (hangata e le thupa e nepahetseng holim'a li-consoles kapa konopo e khethiloeng ho PC) ho "zoom in" ka sebetsa sa hau se sa buuoeng.
4. Sheba ka hloko ** hukung e ka tlaase ka ho le letšehali ** ea skrine sa hau. U tla hlokomela khoele ea khoutu ea binary e hlahang ka bokhutšoane.
5. Khoutu ena ea binary e fetolela lentsoe "Dave" ho boemeli ba binary ba ASCII.

Ka ho latela mehato ena le ho shebella khoutu ea binary, u tla notlolla "I’m Sorry, Dave" phihlello.

halomcc-balaho-s-most-wanted-03c5a591ce.guideDescription: Ho notlolla katleho ea "Balaho’s Most Wanted" ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tla hloka ho tlosa kakaretso e kopaneng ea 100 Grunts ka mokhoa oa PVE, e kenyelletsang Letšolo, Firefight, le Spartan Ops. Ka lehlohonolo, katleho ena e ka notlolloa habonolo ka ho bapala ka mokhoa o tloaelehileng.

halomcc-where-am-i-0ea732d545.description: Qetella mesebetsi e 10 kapa lipapali tsa libapali tse ngata.
halomcc-where-am-i-0ea732d545.guideDescription: Ho notlolla katleho ea "Where Am I?" ka har'a Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), u hloka feela ho phethela kakaretso ea phutuho e 10 kapa lipapali tse 10 tsa libapali tse ngata.

halomcc-the-one-percent-088630ade1.guideDescription: Ho notlolla katleho ea "The One Percent" ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tla hloka ho tlosa kakaretso e kopaneng ea 100 Elites ka mokhoa oa PVE, o kenyelletsang Letšolo, Mollo, le Spartan Ops. Ka lehlohonolo, katleho ena e ka notlolloa habonolo ka ho bapala ka mokhoa o tloaelehileng.

halomcc-we-re-just-getting-started-4fd09.description: Halo: Reach: Qetello e Feletseng ea Mariha.
halomcc-we-re-just-getting-started-4fd09.guideDescription: Ho notlolla katleho ea "We're Just Getting Started" ho Halo: Reach ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o hloka feela ho bapala "Winter Contingency" ho tloha qalong ho isa qetellong ka bothata bofe kapa bofe.

halomcc-spoilsport-3dada00509.guideDescription: Ho notlolla phihlello ea "Spoilsport" ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), u tla hloka ho felisa kakaretso ea Liphokojoe tse 100 ka mokhoa oa PVE, tse kenyelletsang Letšolo, Ntoa ea Mollo, le Spartan Ops. Ka lehlohonolo, katleho ena e ka notlolloa habonolo ka ho bapala ka mokhoa o tloaelehileng.

halomcc-just-a-taste-9a52606cd4.description: Bokella letšolo la 500 kapa likhau tsa lenane la lipina.
halomcc-just-a-taste-9a52606cd4.guideDescription: Ho notlolla katleho ea "Just A Taste" ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o tla hloka ho bokella lets'olo la 500 kapa likhau tsa lenane la lipina. Likhau tsena li ka fumanoa ha u ntse u bapala lets'olo kapa u nka karolo papaling ea papali. Ho holisa tsoelo-pele ea hau, tsepamisa maikutlo ho bolaee lira kapele le ka nepo, u ikemiselitse ho bolaea batho ba bangata le ho bolaea likhau tsa spree. Ho khothaletsoa ho bapala ka mathata a bonolo lets'olong, kaha ho u lumella ho bokella likhau ntle le phephetso e eketsehileng ea mathata a phahameng.

halomcc-protocol-dictates-action-e8ac811.description: Halo: Reach: Tlatsa ONI: Sword Base.
halomcc-protocol-dictates-action-e8ac811.guideDescription: Ho notlolla katleho ea "Protocol Dictates Action" ho Halo: Reach ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o hloka feela ho bapala "Protocol Dictates Action" ho tloha qalong ho isa qetellong ka bothata bofe kapa bofe.

halomcc-stick-with-it-a-little-longer-17.description: Bapala papali ea libapali tse ngata kapa ea co-op bonyane likhoeli tse 3 kamora papali ea hau ea pele.
halomcc-stick-with-it-a-little-longer-17.guideDescription:
Ho notlolla katleho ea "Stick With It...A Little Longer" ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), u hloka feela ho bapala papali ea libapali tse ngata kapa ea kopanelo bonyane likhoeli tse 3 ka mor'a hore u bapale papali ea hau ea pele.

Ho fapana le likatleho tse ling, ena e ke ke ea notlolloa ka ho fetola letsatsi la sistimi ea hau, kaha e netefalitsoe ke seva.

halomcc-pillar-of-autumn-ca48de1ce8.description: Halo CE: Tlatsa Pilara ea Hoetla.
halomcc-pillar-of-autumn-ca48de1ce8.guideDescription: Ho notlolla katleho ea "Pillar of Autumn" ho Halo: CE ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o hloka feela ho bapala "Pillar of Autumn" thomo ho tloha qalong ho isa qetellong ka bothata bofe kapa bofe.

halomcc-the-guardians-are-coming-f21d333.guideDescription:
Katleho ea "The Guardians Are Coming" ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC) e ka notlolloa ka ho kopana le qetello e sa tloaelehang: ho bolaoa ka mokhoa o ferekanyang enjine ea papali. Ha sena se etsahala, papali e atisa ho hlahisa molaetsa, "You were killed by The Guardians." Mona ke mokhoa o hlakileng oa ho fumana katleho ena:

1. Ho menu e kholo ea Halo MCC, khetha lets'olo la Halo 2.
2. Eya ho thomo khetha.
3. Beha lehata la scarab hore le sebetse.
4. Laola thomo ea pele kapa thomo efe kapa efe eo u e ratang.
5. Bapala ho fihlela u fumana sebetsa.
6. Thunya fatše.
7. Katleho e notletsoe!

Haeba u latela mehato ena, u tla ba le "The Guardians Are Coming" pokellong ea hau.

halomcc-my-buddy-chips-b7c213043b.description: Halo CE: Loana haufi le Chips Dubbo 'me u mamele mantsoe a hae a bohlale.
halomcc-my-buddy-chips-b7c213043b.guideDescription:
Ho fumana katleho ea "My Buddy Chips" ho Halo: Combat Evolved ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection, o hloka ho kopana le sebapali sa Chips Dubbo nakong ea lets'olo la Halo: Combat Evolved. A ka fumanoa mesebetsing e fapaneng, empa libapali tse ngata li atlehile mosebetsing "The Pillar of Autumn."

Boloka likepe tsa hau li phela, haholo-holo nakong eo mabotho a Selekane a palamang sekepe sa hau, 'me u mamele lipuisano tse ikhethang tsa Dubbo. Sephetho se tlameha ho buleha ka mor'a kopano ena.

Ke habohlokoa ho hlokomela hore ponahalo ea Chips Dubbo e ka ba ntho e sa tloaelehang, 'me haeba u na le bothata ba ho mo fumana, leka ho pheta-pheta thōmo le ho e nka butle, ho etsa bonnete ba hore u lula le likepe tsa hau le ho mamela lipuisano tsohle tsa bona1.

halomcc-i-need-a-weapon-0305f283a3.guideDescription: Ho notlolla katleho ea "I Need A Weapon" ho Halo: Reach ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o hloka feela ho bapala "Nightfall" ho tloha qalong ho isa qetellong ka bothata bofe kapa bofe.

halomcc-bite-the-hand-cc4675d512.description: Bolaea moqapi oa 343 papaling ea papali kapa motho ea nang le katleho ena.
halomcc-bite-the-hand-cc4675d512.guideDescription: Ho notlolla "Bite The Hand" ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), letoto la papali ea libapali tse ngata le ho bolaea bahanyetsi nakong ea lipapali tse tloaelehileng. Sepheo e ka ba moqapi kapa sebapali leha e le sefe se seng se ntse se e-na le katleho ena, kahoo tsoela pele ho bapala ho fihlela u fumana polao e tšoanelehang. Video e bonts'a mofuta oa mantlha oa Halo 4 oa katleho, e sebelisang mokhoa o ts'oanang oa ho etsa papali.

halomcc-mind-the-skill-gap-566b495f16.description: Halo: Reach: Shebella letšoao la k'hamphani ea merafo e kentsoeng likonopo.
halomcc-mind-the-skill-gap-566b495f16.guideDescription: Ho notlolla "Mind the Skill Gap" ho Halo: Reach ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ho Tip of the Spear, batla logo ea BXR Mining setsing sa merafo. Emisa moo u nang le pono e hlakileng 'me u shebe ka ho toba letšoao la k'hamphani ho qala katleho.

halomcc-to-war-5b5e005c5c.guideDescription: Ho notlolla katleho ea "To War" ho Halo: Reach ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o hloka feela ho bapala "Tip of the Spear" ho tloha qalong ho isa qetellong ka bothata bofe kapa bofe.

halomcc-halo-6ecaacfb1e.guideDescription: Ho notlolla katleho ea "Halo" ho Halo: Combat Evolved ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o hloka feela ho bapala "Halo" ho tloha qalong ho isa qetellong ka bothata bofe kapa bofe.

halomcc-standard-operating-brocedure-ffb.description: Tlatsa boemo bofe kapa bofe ba co-op ho bothata bo Tloaelehileng.
halomcc-standard-operating-brocedure-ffb.guideDescription:
Ho notlolla "Standard Operating Brocedure" phihlello ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o hloka feela ho phethela boemo bofe kapa bofe ba tšebelisano-'moho ho mathata a Tloaelehileng.

U ka boela ua fumana katleho ea "Standard Operating Brocedure" ka ho bapala ka bothata ba Heroic kapa Legendary.

halomcc-going-bananas-a3478a4999.guideDescription: Ho notlolla "Going Bananas" ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), tlosa 100 Brutes. Bapala hape kopano ea Halo 3 kapa Halo 3: ODST e nang le sera sena. Tsoela pele ho hlakola lira tse tšoanelehang ha u ntse u sebetsa ka likatleho tse ling.

halomcc-you-flew-pretty-good-ef665babe8.description: Halo: Reach: Bosiu bo Bolelele ba Matšeliso.
halomcc-you-flew-pretty-good-ef665babe8.guideDescription: Ho notlolla katleho ea "You Flew Pretty Good" ho Halo: Reach ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o hloka feela ho bapala "Long Night of Solace" ho tloha qalong ho isa qetellong ka bothata bofe kapa bofe.

halomcc-truth-and-reconciliation-3d669bd.guideDescription: Ho notlolla katleho ea "Truth and Reconciliation" ho Halo: Combat Evolved ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o hloka feela ho bapala "Truth and Reconciliation" ho tloha qalong ho isa qetellong ka bothata bofe kapa bofe.

halomcc-delicious-brains-a0b4eb557d.guideDescription: Ho notlolla "Delicious Brains" ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), tlosa likhohola tse 100. Bapala hape lets'olo la Moroallo o boima joalo ka Laeborari. Tsoela pele ho hlakola lira tse tšoanelehang ha u ntse u sebetsa ka likatleho tse ling.

halomcc-into-the-howling-dark-faf89601ca.guideDescription: Ho notlolla katleho ea "Into The Howling Dark" ho Halo: Reach ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o hloka feela ho bapala "Exodus" ho tloha qalong ho isa qetellong ka bothata bofe kapa bofe.

halomcc-gruntageddon-bbcb54f8fb.guideDescription: Ho notlolla "Gruntageddon" ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), tlosa 1000 Grunts. Bapala hape morero oa lets'olo la Selekane-boima moo sera se hlahang ka lihlopha. Tsoela pele ho hlakola lira tse tšoanelehang ha u ntse u sebetsa ka likatleho tse ling.

halomcc-front-page-news-951f11d7eb.guideDescription: Ho notlolla "Front Page News" ho Halo: Reach ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), mphumane sehlopheng. Sebelisa video ho khetholla sebaka le mokhoa oa ho atamela. Haeba e le ntho, atamela ho lekana ho sebelisana le eona pele u tsoela pele sebakeng seo.

halomcc-dust-and-echoes-abf0cf7266.description: Halo: Reach: Tlatsa Alexandria e Ncha.
halomcc-dust-and-echoes-abf0cf7266.guideDescription: Ho notlolla "Dust And Echoes" ho Halo: Reach ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), laela New Alexandria ho tloha qalong ka bothata bofe kapa bofe 'me u bapale ho fihlela sepheo sa ho qetela. Latela matšoao a thomo 'me u qete boemo e le hore se hlakileng se tla ngoloa ho Mission Select.

halomcc-the-silent-cartographer-463f102f.description: Halo CE: Tlatsa Setsebi sa Limmapa se Khutsitseng.
halomcc-the-silent-cartographer-463f102f.guideDescription: Ho notlolla "The Silent Cartographer" ho Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kenya The Silent Cartographer ho tloha qalong ka bothata bofe kapa bofe 'me u bapale ho fihlela sepheo sa ho qetela. Fihla setsing sa tšireletso pele ho bula setsi, ebe u theohela ho Moetsi oa Limmapa.

halomcc-what-about-bob-d728d4e4c1.description: Halo: Reach: Fumana le ho felisa e 'ngoe ea li-Elite tsa Ranger Commander tse patiloeng.
halomcc-what-about-bob-d728d4e4c1.guideDescription: Ho notlolla "What About Bob?" ho Halo: Reach ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), fumana le ho felisa e 'ngoe ea li-Elite tsa Ranger Commander tse patiloeng. Sebelisa video ho khetholla sebaka le mokhoa oa ho atamela. Haeba e le ntho, atamela ho lekana ho sebelisana le eona pele u tsoela pele sebakeng seo.

halomcc-easy-to-overlook-7e6f804af3.description: Halo: Reach: Fumana puisano ea seea-le-moea ea UNSC e patiloeng.
halomcc-easy-to-overlook-7e6f804af3.guideDescription: Ho notlolla "Easy to Overlook" ho Halo: Reach ka har'a Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kena lipuisanong tsa radio tsa UNSC tse patiloeng. Qala ho tloha sebakeng se bontšitsoeng videong 'me u latele ho seta ha eona pele u leka ketso.

halomcc-your-heresy-will-stay-your-feet-.description: Halo: Reach: Bolaea Elite Zealot pele a ka baleha nakong ea Tip of the Spear.
halomcc-your-heresy-will-stay-your-feet-.guideDescription: Ho notlolla "Your Heresy Will Stay Your Feet" ho Halo: Reach ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), bolaea Elite Zealot pele a ka baleha nakong ea Tip of the Spear. Sebelisa sebetsa se tšoanang, koloi kapa boemo bo bontšitsoeng videong. Haeba sepheo se hloka ho otla ho itseng ha ho qetela, khaotsa ho sebetsana le tšenyo e 'ngoe hang ha sepheo se fokola.

halomcc-the-chips-dubbo-46489745e0.description: Halo 2: Loana haufi le Chips Dubbo ea tummeng 'me u mamele mantsoe a hae.
halomcc-the-chips-dubbo-46489745e0.guideDescription: Ho notlolla "THE Chips Dubbo?" ho Halo 2: Anniversary ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), bapala Outskirts 'me u lule haufi le Marines ha u ntse u loana nakong ea likopano tse qalang. Boloka Marine ea buang Seaustralia a phela 'me a le haufi ho fihlela u utloa Chips Dubbo a bua. Haeba a e-shoa pele u mo utloa, qala bocha sebakeng sa tlhahlobo se bulehileng.

halomcc-game-on-7965c0c072.description: Qetella mesebetsi e 50 kapa lipapali tsa libapali tse ngata.
halomcc-game-on-7965c0c072.guideDescription: Ho notlolla "Game On" ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qeta kakaretso e kopaneng ea liphutuho tse 50 kapa lipapali tsa libapali tse ngata. U ka fapanyetsana pakeng tsa tsona. Bapala hape liphutuho tse khutšoane tsa lets'olo kapa u lule u le papaling ka liphetho hore sephetho se seng le se seng se rekote.

halomcc-can-t-keep-him-down-21a41e0ec7.description: Halo 3: Loana haufi 'me u mamele Monna. The Legend. Chips Dubbo.
halomcc-can-t-keep-him-down-21a41e0ec7.guideDescription: Ho notlolla "Can't Keep Him Down" ho Halo 3 ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), bapala kopano ea Halo 3 le Marines 'me u lule haufi le Marine e buang Se-Australia ha u ntse u tsoela pele. Mo boloke a phela ’me u mo fe nako ea ho bua nakong ea ntoa kapa ka mor’a eona.

halomcc-this-is-not-your-grave-2625dc7b4.guideDescription: Ho notlolla "This Is Not Your Grave" ho Halo: Reach ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kenya Package ho tloha qalong ka bothata bofe kapa bofe 'me u bapale ho fihlela sepheo sa ho qetela. Latela matšoao a thomo 'me u qete boemo e le hore se hlakileng se tla ngoloa ho Mission Select.

halomcc-brovershield-0ccc5f822c.description: Tlatsa boemo bofe kapa bofe ba co-op ho bothata ba Heroic.
halomcc-brovershield-0ccc5f822c.guideDescription: Ho notlolla "Brovershield" ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), mema mosebetsi-'moho le uena ka har'a Campaign lobby, khetha thomo e khutšoane eo u e tsebang hantle, 'me u behe bothata ho Heroic. Lula ho fireteam le qete thomo hammoho. Hoeletsa litšokelo 'me u boloke sebaka se lekaneng ho qoba ho theoha hammoho.

halomcc-send-me-out-with-a-bang-3c497f2e.description: Halo: Reach: Tlatsa Pilara ea Hoetla.
halomcc-send-me-out-with-a-bang-3c497f2e.guideDescription: Ho notlolla "Send Me Out... With A Bang" ho Halo: Reach ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), laela Pillar of Autumn ho tloha qalong ka bothata bofe kapa bofe 'me u bapale ho fihlela sepheo sa ho qetela. Latela matšoao a thomo 'me u qete boemo e le hore se hlakileng se tla ngoloa ho Mission Select.

halomcc-cairo-station-d8d931daf5.guideDescription: Ho notlolla "Cairo Station" ho Halo 2: Anniversary ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), laela Seteishene sa Cairo ho tloha qalong ka bothata bofe kapa bofe 'me u bapale ho fihlela sepheo sa ho qetela. Sireletsa liteishene tseleng e eang ho bomo, ebe u fihla ho eona ho qeta thomo.

halomcc-assault-on-the-control-room-f130.description: Halo CE: Tlhaselo e Felletseng ka Phaposing ea Taolo.
halomcc-assault-on-the-control-room-f130.guideDescription: Ho notlolla "Assault on the Control Room" ho Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary ka hare ho Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kenya Assault Kamoreng ea Taolo ho tloha qalong ka bothata bofe kapa bofe 'me u bapale ho fihlela sepheo sa ho qetela. Sebelisa likoloi tseleng ea fatše 'me u loane ka marokho ho ea Kamoreng ea Taolo.

halomcc-a-pile-of-medals-f80eff0712.description: Bokella letšolo la 2,000 kapa likhau tsa lenane la lipina.
